neighbours.label: Arabic على ('on') followed by the split-off first letter of a noun right after a verb of taking, carrying or sitting: أخذ على عاتقه (took upon his shoulders), حمل على كتفه (carried on his shoulder), جلس على عرشه (sat on his throne). Quiet for the same nouns after other verbs (ألقى/يقع على عاتق), for whole words after على (على علم, على كرسيه), for ع-words after other prepositions (إلى عمله, عن عمل), and in English or Greek.
